observations.behavior: Adds RPC error handling to schedule pause/unpause wrapper functions.
observations.posthog_connection: These wrappers prevent transient scheduling failures when a schedule is already absent, allowing the warehouse ingestion workflow to proceed without failing due to a missing schedule. This could help PostHog maintain warehouse ingestion stability when schedules are deleted or not found.
